about: Get a medical visa letter, a to-whom-it-may-concern letter or an airport transfer request for treatment abroad. For patients travelling abroad for treatment only.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Only for patients travelling abroad for treatment and their escorts; it is not a general to-whom-it-may-concern letter
Patient and escort passports must not be expired
